name: Grampians murnong gathering
description: A later ecological report describes Aboriginal women locating murnong food plants in the Grampians in an 1841 observation.

date.basis: The date is scoped to this described observation, text, archaeological interpretation or object, not the origin of the wider practice.

events.statement: A later ecological report describes Aboriginal women locating murnong food plants in the Grampians in an 1841 observation.

evidence.supports: The later ecological report says George Robinson recorded Aboriginal women in the Grampians locating murnong on 24 July 1841. This is a colonial observer’s account mediated through a later source, not an origin date or proof of identical land management across Victoria.

events.caveats: The event is an outsider’s 1841 observation paraphrased in a later ecological report; the original journal should be checked. It does not date the beginning of the practice, establish identities of these women or prove that all communities used the same management.
